stemMd: The two real roots of x squared minus 11x plus 24=0 are r and s. What is (r+1)(s+1)?
explanationMd: Expand to rs+r+s+1. The root product is 24 and root sum 11, so the value is 24+11+1=36. Solving individually as 3 and 8 gives the same result.
